# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/yurykissin/CAPVisualizer/security/advisories/new)
to report the issue privately. Include the affected version or commit, impact,
reproduction steps, and any suggested mitigation.

This project handles sensitive tenant configuration. Do not include real tenant
exports, names, credentials, certificates, tokens, or customer data in the
report. Use a minimal synthetic example instead.

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest version on the default branch.
